summary.description: What the PR does and why, at most 600 characters.

kind.description: Short category such as security, data, compat, perf, concurrency, test-gap.

explanation.description: What can go wrong and what to check, at most 600 characters.

file_refs.description: One or more `path:start` or `path:start-end`, path copied exactly from the file lists, lines from the changed ranges.

risks.description: At most 6 risks, most severe first.

file.description: A path copied exactly from the file lists.

line.description: A 1-based line inside a changed range, a finding line or a caller line of that file.

reason.description: Why to look here, at most 160 characters.

review_focus.description: At most 8 places, in the order a reviewer should read them.
